messages:
alice.ops: Quick heads-up — scheduling a segmented maintenance window for us-west1 to validate GPU pairing and apply a NVLink microcode + kernel patch. Window: 2026-04-07 02:00-05:00 UTC. Plan is cohorted node reboots to keep tails steady; expect ~10% shared-pool capacity reduction per cohort for ~25-40m. Reply if this collides with any large runs.

ben.infra: ack. which exact pools?

alice.ops: in-scope: us-west1-gradient and us-west1-playground. We'll do cohorts of ~18-22 nodes, 5 cohorts. Canary will be cohort-1 with traffic split 5%. Steps: preflight checks -> cordon -> graceful drain (grace=30m) -> reboot -> post-boot agent + kernel sanity -> kvcache warmup -> uncordon.

carla-sre: +1 on canary. I'll add an automated rollback flag and a temporary traffic split. If p95 latency > 200ms for 3m OR error rate > 0.8% for 2m we abort and failover to us-west2 fallback.

ben.infra: KV warmup recommendation: run pre-warm 20m before uncordon, TTL=3600, target per-node rps=120. Warm script we use:

```
./scripts/kv_warm --pool us-west1-gradient --threads 8 --rps 120 --duration 900
```

alice.ops: noted. I'll pin heavy models (gpt-large-quant) off the cohorts during the window to reduce cache thrash.

sam.platform: do Dedicated reservations get impacted? We need to PM any tenants with reserved capacity.

alice.ops: Dedicated reservations are isolated; this is shared pool only. We'll still post a targeted heads-up to dedicated-ops and the status page 48h ahead.

carla-sre: cost shout — cross-region backfill traffic and burst capacity will add bills. Rough estimate for full execution with fallback is ~$2.3k. Filing with finance for approval.

ben.infra: adding a preflight NVLINK probe to block cohort if any ECC/link errors show up. Quick check:

```
ipmitool sdr elist | grep -i nvlink || true
# if any 'Error' count > 0 => block cohort and escalate
```

alice.ops: please add that to the preflight checklist. Oncall: mute noisy auto-evac alerts during the drain and tag alerts with maintenance:segmented-uw1 to avoid unnecessary pages.

oncall-bot: scheduled_maintenance created id=SM-20260407-uw1-02 window=2026-04-07T02:00:00Z/2026-04-07T05:00:00Z owner=alice.ops :calendar:

carla-sre: I'll bump trace sampling and add short model-eval runs post-reboot to detect regression noise early. Also updating SLO widgets for the window.

ben.infra: planning a dry-run in staging this Friday 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC to validate drain -> warmup -> uncordon. Will paste dry-run logs here and a short runbook diff.

alice.ops: perfect. Post the dry-run timestamp and outcomes. If no blockers, I'll publish the scheduled status page entry and calendar invite tomorrow. :thumbsup:
